$Comment: Ultimate 'Ice... KING!' (2026-10-21: the 5 quick bolts are a burst attack; the ultimate must be one giant ray, like the Souls-like Bosses Nightlord). Same technique as the Nightlord's Special_Beam_Attack (all JSON): 1.2 s wind-up standing still and a strong hand glow, 0.6 s re-aim, then 7 Selector 'Stab' hit boxes 0.4 s apart along a line 24 blocks long, 3 wide and 3 tall from his feet 1.2 s recovery. 6 x 12 + 24 = 96 ice damage and 7 frost stacks if you stay in it; dodge sideways. The visible ray: the Frost_Beam attachment of the king model (hidden; the fire animation shows and stretches it), as the Nightlord's kamehameha_beam. Animations (2026-10-21): FrostUltimateCharging (wind-up and re-aim, charge orb), FrostUltimateFire set once on the first tick (2.8 s, the Frost_Beam attachment shown and stretched to 24 blocks; set on every tick it would restart each 0.4 s, the Nightlord also sets one animation for the whole attack), FrostUltimateRecovery. Ground phase 1 only (CAE FrostUltimate). ❌ The Nightlord's MovementEffects.LockYaw does not exist in 0.7.2 (MovementEffects has only Disable*/SpeedMultiplier; the server logged it as an unused key), so he keeps turning toward the target while firing. 2026-10-21 (playtest: let me outrun it): AT_Ice_King_Beam_Focus slows his turning while the beam fires; the last tick also freezes 2.5 s. 2026-10-21: the ticks' HitEntity point at their own root files (Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Tick / _Final) instead of inline roots, which went missing after hot reloads and left the middle ticks hitting nobody. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the hit box sat above the visible beam): the beam is drawn on his Head now (art), centred on his look line, so each Stab box is centred on it too: ExtendTop 1.25 / ExtendBottom 1.25 (was 2.5 / 0.5). 2026-10-21 (playtest: the last hit turned to a new direction, with no beam drawn): an NPC Selector skips its first tick (SelectInteraction returns on firstRun with time 0), so 7 selectors of 0.4 s took ~3.03 s; the 2.8 s Beam_Focus and the 2.8 s Fire animation ended before the last one, and the head turned back to the player. Now each selector is 0.37 s (7 x ~0.40 = ~2.8 s, the animation's length) and Beam_Focus lasts 3.1 s, so the head stays locked through the last hit. 2026-10-21 (playtest: much longer range, so he can hit me from the sky or across the field): each Stab box reaches 60 blocks (EndDistance, was 24). The box sweeps from 0 to 60 blocks within each 0.37 s tick (StabSelector), and still needs line of sight. 2026-10-21 (playtest: it aimed at my feet): starts with AT_Ice_King_Beam_Charge on himself for the 1.8 s charge + re-aim, so his head aims at the target's eyes (Template_AT_Ice_King, HeadMotion Watch) and the beam locks onto the body. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the ultimate freezes everything, allies too, without hurting them): every Stab box hits PLAYERS with the damaging root (HitEntityRules, Player matcher) and everything else (his Gunters and snowmen, other mobs) with Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Freeze_Only: frozen, no damage. 2026-10-21 (playtest: hurt every creature but ice creatures, and freeze them all, only with the ultimate): non-players now get Root_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Ultimate_Mob_Tick/_Final (AT_Ice_King_Freeze_Ultimate, which ignores Immunity_Freeze, + the ice damage, which the king's ice creatures resist with AT_Ice_King_Ice_Body). The freeze-only root is gone. 2026-10-21 (playtest: light the ground under the beam): before each hit box a light carrier projectile (Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Beam_Light, invisible, light radius 6, no damage) flies down the beam, so the ground along it stays lit while it fires. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the light went on far past the end of the beam): each light projectile despawns after 0.95 s (ProjectileInteraction Lifetime); at its ~60 blocks/s that is about the beam's 60 blocks. Lower it if the light still overshoots the tip. 2026-10-21 (playtest: a straight red line toward the target first, so the player sees the ray coming and can react): the charge step shows AT_Ice_King_Ultimate_Warning_Line on his feet (copy of the vanilla Gobliterator flamethrower warning: a red strip flat on the ground from his feet forward, 3 wide and 60 long like the beam, that fills over 1.8 s = the charge + re-aim, so it is full when the beam fires). Attached to Origin, so it turns with his body while he re-aims. Ground phase only: in the air the strip would float at his height (phase 4 already marks the players with Ultimate_Warning). 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): VO_Charge when the charge starts, VO_Scream_Long when the beam fires, Frost_Ultimate_Pulse on each of the 7 beam pulses. 2026-10-22 (playtest: only the RAGE ultimate hits his Gunters and snowmen): the beam's non-player hits go to the *_Spare roots, which skip creatures with AT_Ice_King_Ice_Body. 2026-10-22: a particle beam (AT_Ice_King_Ultimate_Beam) was tried on the fire step and dropped (preferred: the model beam); the Frost_Beam attachment, hanging from Chest, is the beam again. 2026-10-22: aim tracer during the charge (six Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Aim_Tracer shots, one every 0.3 s), see the first Projectile step.

Next.$Comment: Slow his turning while the beam fires (AT_Ice_King_Beam_Focus), so the player can outrun the sweep.
Recovery: stays still, the window to punish him.

Aim tracer (2026-10-22): the 1.8 s charge (was Simple 1.2 + Simple 0.6, same animation and hand particles at 0 and 1.2 s, VO_Charge at the start) is now six 0.3 s waits, each after a Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Aim_Tracer shot along his aim: a red line that follows his aim to the player. 2026-10-22 v2 (art pass: the tracer is now the laser itself, a 7.5-block fullbright needle reaching ahead of the projectile; the first version's particle dashes lay flat when he aimed down): one shot every 0.1 s (18 over the 1.8 s charge, 7.5 blocks at 70 b/s), so the needles touch end to end in one continuous line. Hand particles at 0 and 1.2 s, VO_Charge at the start, as before.
